'''Resik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jillsarian/Legends|Jillsarian]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]]<ref name="Cracken's Rebel Operatives" /> at the [[The Broken Tusk (Reuss VIII)|Broken Tusk]] circa [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]].<ref name="Fists of Ion">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/feature20081031.html|text="Fists of Ion"|int=Fists of Ion|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref> Having been harassed multiple times by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Resik was an occasional informant to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]<ref name="Cracken's Rebel Operatives" /> and later [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. He notified [[Eedund Cus]] about the cadaver clause in [[Lobar Aybock]]'s [[Shockboxing/Legends|shockboxing]] contract with [[Torel Vorne]].<ref name="Fists of Ion" />
